mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notifications ( id, user_id, sender_id, sender_name, title, content, type, biz_type, mold_id, read_flag, created_at, read_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{bizType}, #{moldId}, #{readFlag}, #{createdAt}, #{readAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, sender_id, sender_name, title, content, type, biz_type, mold_id, read_flag, created_at, read_at FROM user_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, sender_id, sender_name, title, content, type, biz_type, mold_id, read_flag, created_at, read_at FROM user_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notifications SET read_flag = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
